en: The postcard is divided into three sections, each displaying black-and-white photographs of historical architecture. The left section shows a large round fortified tower with a pointed roof, stone walls, and neighboring buildings. The upper right section depicts a church with twin spires behind a city wall, surrounded by trees and greenery. The lower right section shows a stone archway leading into an old brick or stone enclosure. The text on the card is in German.
